title: Indian Pharmacopoeia 2018 Addendum 2019 is available for sale from IPC and its distributors.
bodyHtml: The Indian Pharmacopoeia 2018 Addendum 2019, w.e.f. 1st October 2019, can be procured from the office of Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission, Sector 23, Raj Nagar, Ghaziabad - 201 002 (UP) through Demand Draft @ Rs. 7,000/- (Rupees Seven thousand only) issued in favour of "Indian Pharmacopoeia Commission" payable at Ghaziabad.
